RDW (Dutch Road Authority) JUST DECLARED TESLA FSD SUPERVISED SAFER THAN OTHER DRIVER ASSISTANCE SYSTEMS

After more than a year and a half of rigorous testing on both their test track and real public roads, the RDW has officially granted Tesla’s FSD Supervised a type approval in the Netherlands.

The most powerful line from their official statement:

“Due to the continuous strict monitoring of the driver in the vehicle, the system is safer than other driver assistance systems.”




Elon Musk (@elonmusk)

RDW was extremely rigorous in their review

RDW (Dutch Road Authority) JUST GAVE TESLA FSD SUPERVISED A FULL TYPE APPROVAL — AND THE TESTING WAS INSANE

The RDW didn’t just rubber-stamp it.
They spent more than a year and a half rigorously testing Tesla’s FSD Supervised on both their test track and real public roads before issuing this provisional type approval in the Netherlands (with potential expansion across the EU).

Key highlights from the official RDW statement:

•  They call FSD Supervised an advanced driver assistance system that makes a positive contribution to road safety.
•  Safety was the top priority throughout the entire testing process.
•  The driver remains fully responsible and must stay alert at all times (hands on wheel when required, eyes on road, etc.).
•  They’ve now officially validated that the system is safe enough for real-world use under supervised conditions.

This is a huge regulatory win for Tesla in Europe. The RDW is known for being extremely thorough and safety-focused — the fact that they approved FSD Supervised after 18+ months of intense testing shows just how seriously they take this technology.
Europe is slowly opening the door.




Elon Musk (@elonmusk)
